title: Dovin Baan | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about Dovin Baan, the Magic: The Gathering Planeswalker, who can see the flaws in any system or machine.

paragraphs.text: Dovin can clearly see the flaws in any system or machine and predict with startling accuracy exactly how and when it will fail. He frequently uses his powers to worm his way into positons of authority where his will can be done.
